sd.description: Raw block SD card flasher for Orange Pi RV2 Debian Trixie (root labeled rvdk_sd_root)
post_flash_notes: Orange Pi RV2 SD card boot & on-board eMMC bootstrap:
1. Insert SD card into Orange Pi RV2 (BootROM prioritizes MicroSD over onboard eMMC).
2. Power on and SSH as factory account (orangepi / orangepi or root / orangepi).
3. (If cold RTC predates TLS cert) Sync clock: sudo date -u -s "$(curl -fsSI http://rvdk.drewv-labs.dev/ | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^[Dd]ate: //p')"
4. Run Day-0 bootstrap on SD: curl -fsSL https://rvdk.drewv-labs.dev/bootstrap.sh | sudo bash -s -- --user rvadmin --hostname rv-rv2-sd --nopasswd
5. Bootstrap onboard eMMC from the running SD card: sudo rvdk flash rv2 emmc [--hostname rv-rv2-emmc]

emmc.description: On-board SD -> eMMC bootstrapper (full-disk ext4 rvdk_emmc_root + Ky/SpacemiT boot0/U-Boot SPL)
post_flash_notes: Orange Pi RV2 eMMC bootstrapped from SD (labeled rvdk_emmc_root with unique UUID & boot0/U-Boot SPL):
• Keep MicroSD inserted to boot SD role (rvdk_sd_root).
• Power off and eject MicroSD to boot onboard eMMC role (rvdk_emmc_root).
